title: Hearing on voting access for people held at Rikers
summary: The Council held a joint oversight hearing on voting and voter registration for people in Department of Correction custody, alongside two bills. Int. 786 would require DOC and the Board of Elections to create procedures for curing defective ballots and report five years of related data. Int. 797 would require DOC to issue an annual report on voter registration forms collected, absentee ballots distributed and voting-promotion events, broken down by demographic factors.
